query:
UPDATE rb_team SET content_blocks_dirty = TRUE
            WHERE game_id = (
                SELECT COALESCE(p.game_id, r.game_id)
                FROM rb_content_block cb
                LEFT JOIN rb_puzzle p ON p.id = cb.puzzle_id
                LEFT JOIN rb_round r ON r.id = cb.round_id
                WHERE cb.id = $1
            )
